purpose: An illustrative quieter acquisition for new cases, not a claim of greater clinical realism.

candidate.selection: Fixed before comparison; no parameter search

morphologyGate.reference: Same case with ideal acquisition; paired engineering comparison only

negativeControls: manual artifacts remain independent of the floor profile
residualMorphology: Characterize ideal-acquisition irregularities; do not smooth or retrain learned shapes without source support.
referenceData: Original PTB-XL records with explicit quality selection and known-patient exclusion; exploratory only because historical exposure inventory is incomplete.
screenExport: Existing independent pixel oracle, unchanged 2 px tolerance and negative controls; inspect actual production PNG and independent sample plots.
failurePolicy: Retain all failures and per-family results. Do not promote the default if a preregistered gate fails. Do not silently revise thresholds or select seeds after seeing results.
independentClinicalReview: Not available; required before claiming improved clinical plausibility.
